events.name: Chicago White Sox at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami hit a two-run homer, five Chicago pitchers combined for a three-hitter and the White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of their AL Division Series on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox beat Guardians 3-0 in Game 1 of ALDS behind Murakami homer, 3-hitter
